question: What are the standard working hours at Nandes Tech?
ground_truth: Standard working hours are 09:00-18:00 WIB with a one-hour lunch between 12:00 and 14:00. Core collaboration hours are 10:00-16:00 WIB.

question: List all the public holidays Nandes Tech observes in 2026.
ground_truth: Twelve holidays: New Year's Day (1 Jan), Lunar New Year (17 Feb), Nyepi (19 Mar), Idul Fitri day 1 (20 Mar), Idul Fitri day 2 (21 Mar), Labour Day (1 May), Ascension Day (14 May), Waisak (27 May), Pancasila Day (1 Jun), Independence Day (17 Aug), Christmas Day (25 Dec), and collective leave (26 Dec).

question: How many unused annual leave days can I carry into next year and when do they expire?
ground_truth: Up to five unused days may be carried over, and they expire on 31 March.

question: When do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
ground_truth: From the third consecutive day of absence. Sick leave is capped at 14 paid days per year.

question: What is the notice period after probation for a manager?
ground_truth: Two months for managers and above; one month for individual contributors. During probation it is two weeks on either side.

question: In which review cycle are promotions decided?
ground_truth: Promotions are decided only in the December cycle. Reviews run in June and December.

question: How many days per week do I have to be in the office, and which days do engineering teams use?
ground_truth: Two days per week; most engineering teams use Tuesday and Thursday as anchor days.

question: Can I work from another country, and for how long?
ground_truth: Up to 30 calendar days per year without a contract change. Longer stays need People Ops and Finance approval before booking travel, and you must still cover 10:00-16:00 WIB core hours.

question: How much is the home office stipend and what does it cover?
ground_truth: IDR 7,500,000 one-time on joining plus IDR 2,500,000 per year for renewals. It covers desks, chairs, monitors, and headsets, but not rent, electricity, or internet subscriptions.

question: Is there a monthly internet allowance for remote employees?
ground_truth: Yes, IDR 500,000 per month paid with salary, with no receipts required.

question: What do I need to do before working from a cafe, and can I open customer data there?
ground_truth: Connect to the company VPN and enable your privacy screen. Customer data must never be handled from a public space, and calls about customers, salaries, or incidents must not be taken there.

question: How long do I have to return my laptop after leaving?
ground_truth: Within five working days of your last day; unreturned equipment is deducted from the final salary payment at book value.

question: What is the meal cap per day for domestic travel?
ground_truth: IDR 400,000 per day in total, not per meal.

question: What is the hotel cap per night for a trip to Germany?
ground_truth: IDR 3,500,000 per night, the Europe and North America cap.

question: Who has to approve an expense of IDR 8,000,000 before I spend it?
ground_truth: The department director, since it falls in the 5,000,001-25,000,000 band.

question: Can I expense wine at a client dinner?
ground_truth: No. Alcohol is never reimbursable, including on client dinners.

question: How long do I have to submit an expense claim?
ground_truth: Within 30 days of the spend date. Claims older than 60 days are rejected automatically.

question: When can I fly premium economy or business class?
ground_truth: Premium economy is allowed on flights scheduled above eight hours with director approval. Business class requires CFO approval. Economy is the default.

question: What is the limit for client entertainment per attendee?
ground_truth: IDR 750,000 per attendee, and the claim must list the client company and every attendee by name.

question: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
ground_truth: No. Only hardware keys or authenticator apps are accepted; SMS codes are not.

question: What is the minimum password length?
ground_truth: At least 14 characters, unique per service, stored in 1Password.

question: How quickly do I have to report a phishing email or a lost laptop?
ground_truth: Immediately, and always within one hour of noticing, to security@nandes.tech. A lost or stolen laptop must also be reported to your manager the same day.

question: Who gets write access to the production database?
ground_truth: Production access is read-only by default and needs a ticket with a purpose and expiry. Standing write access goes only to on-call engineers for the duration of their rotation.

question: We want to start using a new SaaS analytics tool that stores customer data. What approvals do we need?
ground_truth: It needs a security review before purchase (up to ten working days, free tiers included), and it goes through procurement: request with business case, security review, legal review of the contract and DPA, finance approval, then signature by the CEO or CFO.

question: List everything I need to do on my first day as an engineer.
ground_truth: Collect and enrol your laptop, set up 1Password with a hardware key or authenticator app for email, GitHub and VPN, accept the GitHub org invitation to nandes-tech, join #eng-general, #eng-oncall and your team channel, and read the IT security policy and confirm in the onboarding ticket.

question: How many approvals does a pull request to the infra repository need?
ground_truth: Two approving reviews, as with authentication code. Other changes need one.

question: How often is staging refreshed from production?
ground_truth: Every Sunday at 02:00 WIB, from a scrubbed production snapshot.

question: When are deploys frozen?
ground_truth: From 16:00 WIB Friday until Monday morning, and during declared incidents. The freeze is automatic for the duration of any SEV1 or SEV2.

question: What is the salary range for a Senior Engineer?
ground_truth: E3 Senior Engineer: IDR 28,000,000 minimum, 35,000,000 mid, 42,000,000 maximum gross monthly base.

question: At which levels do people get equity, and what is the vesting schedule?
ground_truth: Equity is granted at E3 and above and P3 and above, vesting over four years with a one-year cliff and monthly vesting thereafter.

question: How big is the annual bonus and when is it paid?
ground_truth: Target is one month of base salary at 100% company performance, paid in March, with individual multipliers from 0.5 to 1.5 based on the December review rating.

question: What is the annual dental limit on the health insurance?
ground_truth: IDR 6,000,000 per person per year.

question: Can I use the wellness allowance for therapy or for supplements?
ground_truth: Therapy is covered by the IDR 3,600,000 annual wellness allowance; supplements and cosmetic treatments are not.

question: How much parental leave does a non-birthing parent get?
ground_truth: Eight weeks, which can be taken in up to three blocks within the first year after birth or adoption.

question: I want to attend a conference abroad. Which budget pays for it and which travel limits apply?
ground_truth: Conference travel comes out of the IDR 15,000,000 annual learning budget, not the travel budget, but it follows the expense policy travel caps for the region.

question: Are counselling sessions free, and do they use up my wellness allowance?
ground_truth: Six sessions per year are free through the SehatPlus employee assistance programme and do not consume the wellness allowance.

question: List all the incident severity levels and their response times.
ground_truth: SEV1 full outage or data at risk, 15 minutes; SEV2 major feature broken with no workaround, 30 minutes; SEV3 degraded performance or a workaround exists, 4 hours; SEV4 cosmetic or low impact, next working day.

question: Who is required on a SEV1 incident besides the incident commander?
ground_truth: A communications lead is mandatory for SEV1 and SEV2, plus a scribe to record the timeline. The incident commander is not hands on keyboard.

question: Which incidents need a postmortem and by when?
ground_truth: SEV1 and SEV2 need a blameless written postmortem within five working days. SEV3 and SEV4 only if the incident commander asks.

question: How does the on-call rotation work and how fast must I acknowledge a page?
ground_truth: The rotation is weekly, handing over Wednesday at 10:00 WIB. Primary must acknowledge within 15 minutes; secondary is paged after 20 minutes without acknowledgement.

question: Who is allowed to sign a vendor contract?
ground_truth: Only the CEO and the CFO may sign contracts on behalf of the company.

question: Which observability vendor should we use?
ground_truth: Grafana Cloud is the preferred observability vendor. Using a non-preferred vendor needs director approval and a written justification.

question: Do we need to compare alternatives before renewing a large vendor contract?
ground_truth: Yes, any contract renewing above IDR 100,000,000 per year needs a fresh market comparison of at least two alternatives. Owners are notified 90 days before renewal.

question: Has the domestic meal cap changed since the 2024 policy?
ground_truth: Yes. The 2024 policy capped meals at IDR 300,000 per day; the current policy caps them at IDR 400,000 per day.

question: What does a Senior Engineer earn this year?
ground_truth: Under the 2026 bands, E3 Senior Engineer is IDR 28,000,000 to 42,000,000 gross monthly base, with a mid-point of 35,000,000.

question: How far ahead can I book a desk, and what happens if I do not check in?
ground_truth: Desks are booked in Deskly up to two weeks ahead. Bookings not checked in by 10:30 are released to the pool.

question: Which floor is the quiet floor and what are the rules there?
ground_truth: Floor 12 is the quiet floor: no calls and no meetings.

question: What is the commission rate on enterprise deals and when is it paid?
ground_truth: 5% on enterprise deals, paid quarterly one month after quarter close, and only on cash collected.

question: Does the sales team have its own travel budget for client visits?
ground_truth: No. Sales has no separate travel budget; client visits follow the normal travel process and the company expense caps. Client entertainment above the standard per-attendee limit needs VP Sales approval in advance.

question: Can an account executive sign off a 25 percent discount on their own?
ground_truth: No. An account executive may approve up to 10%. A 21-30% discount needs VP Sales approval.
